meta.title: Ito: swap a pattern
meta.description: Hover a section for Edit layout: other patterns with the same blocks, showing the section's own content. Pick one and the layout changes, the words and pictures stay.
meta.author: Automattic

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
// No welcome guides or pattern picker in the way.
update_user_meta( 1, $wpdb->prefix . 'persisted_preferences', array(
	'core/edit-post' => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false ),
	'core/edit-site' => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false, 'welcomeGuidePage' => false, 'welcomeGuideTemplate' => false ),
	'core' => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false, 'enableChoosePatternModal' => false ),
	'_modified' => gmdate( 'c' ),
) );
// The sample page, as the home page too.
if ( function_exists( 'ito_create_sample_page' ) ) {
	$id = ito_create_sample_page();
	if ( $id ) {
		update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
		update_option( 'page_on_front', $id );
	}
}
